plugins.name: skill-suites-ops
plugins.description: Turns a pile of installed skills into a plan that picks which to run and in what order, runs them with backups and check-ins, and remembers which sequences worked.

skills.name: ops-assess
skills.description: Monitors a multi-skill plan the operator is running by hand against its operations order (OPORD) — checking each step's output, applying the order's adaptation rules, asking whether the plan's frame still holds at phase boundaries, and writing the execution report. Use when the operator is running an OPORD's skills themselves and wants each step checked, asks to assess or monitor execution, or wants a partly-run plan evaluated. Not for code review, QA, or general assessments, and not for automated execution (ops-run).
headings: Phase 1: The Loop, Step by Step
skills.description_zh: 按 OPORD 检查人员手动执行多技能计划的各步骤输出，应用调整规则、阶段性确认计划前提并写执行报告；不用于自动运行或一般 QA。

skills.name: ops-learn
skills.description: Promotes recurring, successful skill sequences from the ops pattern queue into the opening book that ops-plan consults first, records known-bad sequences, and ages out plans that have gone unused. Use when the operator asks to update or review the opening book, promote learned patterns, or close the learning loop after several ops-run or ops-assess executions. Not for model training or general "what did we learn" retrospectives.
skills.description_zh: 将重复成功的技能序列从模式队列提升到 ops-plan 优先参考的开局库，记录失败序列并淘汰久未使用计划，闭合执行学习循环。

skills.name: ops-order
skills.description: Turns the recommended plan from ops-plan into a full five-paragraph operations order (OPORD) that ops-run can execute, with per-skill tasking, backup skills, and pre-committed adaptation rules. Use when the operator has a plan from ops-plan and wants it made executable, asks for an OPORD, or wants tasking and contingencies written before running a multi-skill effort. Not for general task lists, project plans, or tickets.
skills.description_zh: 把 ops-plan 建议转成 ops-run 可执行的五段式 OPORD，明确各技能任务、备选技能及预先约定的调整规则；不用于一般任务清单。

skills.name: ops-plan
skills.description: Works out which installed skills to run, in what order, for a problem that needs more than one skill, and writes a tactical assessment with a recommended plan. Use when the operator asks which skills to use for a goal, wants a multi-step effort planned or its options compared before running anything, or says "plan this" about work their skill library could do. Not for general project planning, roadmaps, or questions about military doctrine itself.
headings: Ops Plan — METT-TC Mission Analysis + COA Development
Phase 1: Run Directory and Force Roster
skills.description_zh: 为需要多个技能的问题选择已安装技能及执行顺序，比较方案并撰写战术评估和推荐计划；不用于通用路线图或军事理论问答。

skills.name: ops-recon
skills.description: Inventories the Agent Skills installed for the current project and user and sorts them into a force roster by kind of work (capability class) and weight (tier). Use when the operator asks what skills they have, wants their skill library inventoried or mapped, or before planning a multi-skill effort with ops-plan when no fresh roster exists. Not for questions about how a single skill works, or about the agent host's own features.
skills.description_zh: 盘点当前项目和用户已安装的 Agent Skills，按能力类型与等级整理技能编组，为多技能规划提供最新清单。

skills.name: ops-run
skills.description: Executes an operations order (OPORD) from ops-order phase by phase — launching each skill as a subagent, applying its pre-committed adaptation rules, stopping at operator checkpoints, and keeping resumable state. Use when the operator wants an OPORD executed, asks to run or resume the plan, or wants to start from a given phase. Not for producing the plan (ops-plan, ops-order), for monitoring skills the operator runs by hand (ops-assess), or for running a single skill directly.
skills.description_zh: 按阶段执行 ops-order 的 OPORD，将各技能交给子智能体，应用预定调整规则、在人为检查点暂停并保存可恢复状态；不用于制定计划或检查人员手动执行。
